items.name: THORChain ATOM 金库
items.note: 跨链 / 兑换协议（THORChain、Chainflip 等）的公共金库，存的是协议流动性，所有用户的兑换都从这里进出。攻击者把钱转进金库只是在用这个协议兑换，换出的钱付到攻击者自己的收款地址（我们跟的是那一头）；从金库转出的钱付给的是各个用户，金库本身不是攻击者控制的地址。
items.note_en: Public vault of a cross-chain / swap protocol (THORChain, Chainflip, …). It holds protocol liquidity and every user's swaps go in and out through it. The attacker sending funds into it means they used the protocol to swap; the output is paid to the attacker's own receiving address, which we track. Payouts from the vault go to many different users — the vault itself is not controlled by the attacker.
